\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 242-245 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:IT-R250-first-pass-words-from-chapters-242-245}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a pharmacist and a butcher.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to slow down, to breathe, to give up, to collect, to turn to
  \item a plaster, an ambulance, a sick bay, an emergency, an accident
  \item exactly, almost, about, only, together
  \item smooth, rough, deep, fat, unknown
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To slow down? (\textbf{rallentare}.) To breathe? (\textbf{respirare}.) To give up? (\textbf{rinunciare}.) To collect? (\textbf{riscuotere}.) To turn to? (\textbf{rivolgersi}.) A plaster? (\textbf{il cerotto}.) An ambulance? (\textbf{l'ambulanza}.) A sick bay? (\textbf{l'infermeria}.) An emergency? (\textbf{l'emergenza}.) An accident? (\textbf{l'incidente}.) Exactly? (\textbf{proprio}.) Almost? (\textbf{quasi}.) About? (\textbf{circa}.) Only? (\textbf{soltanto}.) Together? (\textbf{insieme}.) Smooth? (\textbf{liscio}.) Rough? (\textbf{ruvido}.) Deep? (\textbf{profondo}.) Fat? (\textbf{grasso}.) Unknown? (\textbf{sconosciuto}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 246-250 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:IT-R250-second-pass-words-from-chapters-246-250}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for ancient and young.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item ancient, young, spicy, raw, cooked
  \item a button, a size, a colour, salad, a snack
  \item temperature, a fly, a mosquito, society, the government
  \item a dialect, a piece of news, the TV news, TV, advertising
  \item a journalist, an architect, a dentist, a pharmacist, a butcher
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Ancient? (\textbf{antico}.) Young? (\textbf{giovane}.) Spicy? (\textbf{piccante}.) Raw? (\textbf{crudo}.) Cooked? (\textbf{cotto}.) A button? (\textbf{il bottone}.) A size? (\textbf{la taglia}.) A colour? (\textbf{il colore}.) Salad? (\textbf{l'insalata}.) A snack? (\textbf{lo spuntino}.) Temperature? (\textbf{la temperatura}.) A fly? (\textbf{la mosca}.) A mosquito? (\textbf{la zanzara}.) Society? (\textbf{la società}.) The government? (\textbf{il governo}.) A dialect? (\textbf{il dialetto}.) A piece of news? (\textbf{la notizia}.) The TV news? (\textbf{il telegiornale}.) TV? (\textbf{la televisione}.) Advertising? (\textbf{la pubblicità}.) A journalist? (\textbf{il giornalista}.) An architect? (\textbf{l'architetto}.) A dentist? (\textbf{il dentista}.) A pharmacist? (\textbf{il farmacista}.) A butcher? (\textbf{il macellaio}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
